body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Shure showcased its Dynamic MicroSpeaker II 'SE115' at CES 2010.
The SE115 uses Dynamic MicroSpeaker technology and sound isolation sleeves that block outside noise to deliver warm, detailed audio and comfortable, personalized fit.
